title: WorkResult
description: What a work Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result work. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

title.description: The PR title, used as is.

implementationSummary.description: For 'done': 10-50 words on what the diff changed (not the ask restated). Shown on the ticket once it closes by merge.

children.description: For outcome split, on a child of a split feature only: the drafts, in order, that replace this ticket in the parent's plan; the design run's child shape.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.

title.description: The child issue's title, filed as is.

body.description: The child issue's markdown body; the engine reads its sections.

kind.description: Branched on: which flow the child is filed for.

featureMode.description: Ignored: a feature child takes its parent's mode. Omit it.

points.description: The child's story points (bots/story-points.md), at most 13: recorded on the filed child.
